exceptions.rationale: Gate 5 R5 Silver protocol conformance requires the Router/CSP session bridge to read the SDK session identifier and session settings; PR31 records the reviewed, time-bounded exception for these three metadata accessors, with re-review at expiry.
Gate 2 classified-memory enforcement requires explicit policy error, write context, and authorized retrieval boundaries; these are governance interfaces rather than new end-user capabilities.

Gate 5 R6 routing hardening adds two production-safety helpers that force-disable legacy agent dispatch (403) and fail readiness closed when misconfigured; these tighten, not expand, the router capability surface. PR32 records the reviewed, time-bounded exception for the two new router_entrypoints, with re-review at expiry.
